scope: Historical public scientific archive qualification only. No live telemetry, operational tracking, source identity classifier, signal suppression, or spectrum processing. No automatic label promotion.

selection.order: Evenly spaced deterministic indices over sorted paired label/data filenames, no spectral outcome selection.

cassini.caveat: NASA reports historical open-loop files screened for gaps; individual file continuity and labels still unverified in our experiment.

natural_control.name: W3 OH maser
natural_control.gate: Published figure qualifies natural signal as literature evidence only; exact archive file, metadata, original frequency/time array, and independently dated repeat observations required before protected exam. Query metadata only; no power read.

rules: Nominal duration from PDS label START_TIME/STOP_TIME is not continuity; actual record counters and dropout decoding require original format docs and separate audit. Do not infer effective sample rate from recorded file bytes alone.

Contiguous or overlapping tapes, polarization/band/receiver variations in a single occultation are not independent sessions. Two spacecraft and two campaigns do not constitute same-frequency controlled discrimination; instrument and propagation confounds.
Cassini gap-free statement is archive-level documentation, not independent validation by JANUS.
S/X broad band labels do not establish exact same carrier. No raw reads or source classifier.
